name: CGI product renders
tagline: Hyper-real product hero shots — coloured rim-light pair + 25° low-angle / 90° top-down / extreme macro vocabulary. Same composition language across two brand palettes (dark-tech and kawaii-yellow-pink).
description: How to prompt an image model so the output reads as a premium CGI product render — the visual language of Nothing Phone launch stills, hyper-motion product ads, tech-porn macro hero shots. Covers the reusable shot grammar (front hero, 3/4 low-angle, top-down back, macro screen, PCB tech-porn) and the two palettes that ride on top (dark-cinematic-with-electric-blue-magenta vs sunny-kawaii-yellow-pink).
